thread:
deploy-bot: starting cutover window for release v2026.03.19 — pinned variants: api@v12, runtime@v9, router@v7, console@v4. wave=1 -> 10% traffic. runbook RB-452. monitoring hooks enabled.
alice: quick check — EU cluster still on v12 candidate or did we pin to v11? we need to avoid header-split churn.
raj: EU is on v12-candidate. kernel-batching flag will be toggled in wave2. watch kv eviction tail.
marie: console has a migration hook for feature flags — will disable in wave1. leaving ui-rollout off.
sre-ci: prod health-checks: api 200s=99.98%, p95 latency 92ms. no errors in last 15m. alerting channel: #incidents.
oliver: router: prepared a fallback route to stable v7-stable if error-rate > 1% or p95 doubles. staging test SHA: 3f8a9b2.
alice: rollback criteria — if error-rate > 1% for 5 min OR tail latency > 2x for 10 min? also low QPS spike from routing mismatch.
raj: agreed. add KV eviction > 0.5% within 10m as a hard stop (eviction causes cache cold start).
marie: adding release-note snippet: "Pinned console v4, UI flags disabled; backend schema compat verified." I'll push to release-notes doc.
deploy-bot: wave1 traffic applied (10%). health summary: api ok, runtime ok, router errors 0.08%. linking logs: https://deploys.redwood.local/logs/5791234567
alice: seeing a few 503s from router for a handful of routes, digging. tagging @oliver and @raj :eyes:
oliver: i see 503s tied to header-swap path. temporary revert: router rule id=hdr-swap-23 -> fallback to v7-stable. executing now.
deploy-bot: initiating fallback to v7-stable for header path. traffic shifted back for affected routes. wave1 still 10% overall.
raj: KV eviction spiked to 0.6% for ~3m in one shard — hitting rollback threshold. recommending abort and rollback to previous pinned versions across stack.
marie: concur. hold further waves. notifying support and CS for any customer impact.
alice: I'll open rollback PR/ops run: command:
```
./deploy rollback --runbook RB-452 --components api runtime router console --target v2026.02.28 --reason "KV eviction spike and router 503s"
```
sre-ci: starting automated rollback checks. ETA ~6m. alerts flaring to on-call.
deploy-bot: rollback job started (job id rb-5791234567). will post updates. :thumbsup:
oliver: after rollback completes, let's schedule a narrow canary for header-swap in staging with header-traffic=1% and KV metrics observed for 30m.
alice: agreed. post-rollback action items: 1) root cause on header-swap config 2) KV tuning 3) adjust rollout gating to include eviction metric.
marie: releasing a concise post-cutover note to #release-updates after rollback finishes.
deploy-bot: rollback complete. all components pinned to v2026.02.28. health: api p95 85ms, router errors 0.02%, KV eviction 0.01%. closing cutover RB-452. :white_check_mark:
alice: thanks everyone. filing a follow-up doc with timeline and metrics.
